senses.gloss:
Pika, the Indian ‘cuckoo,’ is mentioned in the list of victims
at the Aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’) in the Yajurveda Saṃ-
hitās.^1 Cf. Anyavāpa, Koka.
1) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 5, 15, 1;
Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 20; Vāja-
saneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 39. Cf. Zimmer,
Altindisches Leben, 92.
